newsitem.title: USA: Florida approves $425 million of highway bonds.
newsitem.headline: Florida approves $425 million of highway bonds.

text.p: Florida officials gave final approval Thursday for two series of Department of Transportation toll revenue bonds totalling $425 million.

The first series, a $65 million DOT issue for improvements on Alligator Alley, is to be sold in late June or early July. The other series, a $350 million issue of Florida Turnpike revenue bonds, is expected in March 1998.
Both are to be sold by competitive bid through the Florida Division of Bond Finance.
The bonds won final approval Thursday from the state Board of Administration, made up of the governor, comptroller and treasurer.
Florida's DOT previosly won approval for a $350 million general obligation bond issue for highway rights of way and bridge construction. That issue is to be competitively bid in July or August.
